metadata.description: Partial audit checklist for remaining properties (Run 3 of iterative generation)

checklist.title: Verify Hub transfer root updates only occur from authenticated Verifier EIDs
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate _lzReceive() in Hub.sol
2. Verify srcEid is validated against registered Verifier EIDs before root storage
3. Confirm transferRoots mapping update only occurs after EID validation
4. Check that no alternative paths exist to update transferRoots
5. Verify event TransferRootUpdated is emitted with correct parameters
6. Confirm DATA-TRANSFER-ROOT and DATA-TOKEN-INFO are correctly associated

executable_checks.assertion: transferRoots mapping updates are preceded by EID validation
Verifier EID registry exists for validation
Unauthorized EIDs cannot update transfer roots

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-HUB-UPDATE-TRANSFER-ROOT -> Node ACTION-HUB-UPDATE-TRANSFER-ROOT. Reachability: UNREACHABLE - Update only occurs after EID validation. Storage is atomic.

checklist.title: Verify TransferRootUpdated event data matches stored transfer root values
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate TransferRootUpdated event definition in Hub.sol
2. Verify event emission occurs immediately after storage write
3. Confirm event parameters use same values as storage assignment
4. Check no intermediate operations can modify values between storage and event
5. Verify event indexed parameters match storage keys

executable_checks.command: Compare storage assignment line with event emission line
executable_checks.assertion: Same values used in both operations

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-UPDATED -> Node STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-UPDATED. Reachability: UNREACHABLE - Event emission uses same values as storage write in same transaction.

checklist.title: Verify broadcast produces deterministic result even when called with unchanged roots
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate broadcastAggregationRoot() function in Hub.sol
2. Verify function can be called regardless of root update state
3. Confirm broadcast with unchanged roots produces same aggregation result
4. Check that empty broadcasts don't corrupt state
5. Verify gas cost for unnecessary broadcasts (economic consideration)

executable_checks.assertion: Repeated broadcasts with same state produce same result

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-AWAITING-BROADCAST -> Node STATE-AWAITING-BROADCAST. Reachability: REACHABLE_BENIGN - Broadcast can technically be called anytime but produces deterministic result. Empty/unchanged broadcasts waste gas but don't affect security.

checklist.title: Verify PoseidonT3 aggregation is deterministic and matches expected tree construction
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate aggregation computation logic in Hub.sol
2. Verify PoseidonT3 hash function is used
3. Confirm tree construction follows deterministic ordering
4. Check same inputs always produce same aggregation root
5. Verify no randomness or timestamp dependencies in computation
6. Confirm DATA-AGGREGATION-ROOT is correctly computed

executable_checks.assertion: Same inputs produce same aggregation root
No non-deterministic operations in computation path

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-HUB-COMPUTE-AGGREGATION -> Node ACTION-HUB-COMPUTE-AGGREGATION. Reachability: UNREACHABLE - PoseidonT3 is a deterministic hash function. Tree construction is pure function of input roots. Cryptographic guarantee: Poseidon hash determinism.

checklist.title: Verify aggSeq is strictly monotonically increasing with no reset capability
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate aggSeq state variable in Hub.sol
2. Verify only increment operations exist (no decrement/reset)
3. Check increment uses unchecked block or safe math
4. Confirm no admin function can reset aggSeq
5. Verify overflow is practically infeasible (uint256)
6. Check aggSeq is used consistently in global root identification

executable_checks.assertion: aggSeq variable exists and is only incremented
No decrement or reset operations exist (should return no matches)
aggSeq strictly increases with each broadcast

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-HUB-INCREMENT-AGG-SEQ -> Node ACTION-HUB-INCREMENT-AGG-SEQ. Reachability: UNREACHABLE - aggSeq uses unchecked increment. No decrement or reset functions exist. Overflow infeasible for practical usage.

checklist.title: Verify identical global root message sent to all registered Verifiers in broadcast
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate broadcastAggregationRoot() function in Hub.sol
2. Verify message payload is constructed ONCE before iteration loop
3. Confirm same payload variable used in all _lzSend calls
4. Check no payload modification within iteration
5. Verify all registered Verifier EIDs receive the message
6. Confirm DATA-GLOBAL-TRANSFER-ROOT and DATA-LAYERZERO-MESSAGE consistency

executable_checks.command: Verify payload bytes constructed before loop

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-HUB-BROADCAST-ROOT -> Node ACTION-HUB-BROADCAST-ROOT. Reachability: UNREACHABLE - Broadcast iterates over registered Verifiers sending same message payload. Message construction precedes iteration.

checklist.title: Verify broadcast handles partial LayerZero delivery failures gracefully
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Review LayerZero _lzSend error handling in Hub.sol
2. Check if individual send failures revert entire broadcast
3. Verify failed destinations don't corrupt Hub state
4. Confirm event emission reflects actual send attempts
5. Check if retry mechanism exists for failed sends

executable_checks.assertion: LayerZero send with or without error handling

executable_checks.command: Review error handling for partial broadcast failures
executable_checks.assertion: Hub state remains consistent on partial failures

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-BROADCAST -> Node STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-BROADCAST. Reachability: REACHABLE_PARTIAL - LayerZero message submission can fail for individual destinations. However, this is infrastructure failure, not security bypass. Failed Verifiers simply won't have latest global root.

checklist.title: Verify Verifier only stores global roots from authorized Hub EID
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate _lzReceive() in Verifier.sol
2. Verify srcEid is validated against configured hubEid
3. Confirm globalTransferRoots update only occurs after Hub EID validation
4. Check no alternative paths exist to update global roots
5. Verify hubEid is immutable or admin-protected
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-VERIFIER-SAVE-GLOBAL-ROOT -> Node ACTION-VERIFIER-SAVE-GLOBAL-ROOT. Reachability: UNREACHABLE - Verifier._lzReceive validates source EID matches configured Hub EID. Cryptographic guarantee: LayerZero guardian supermajority.

checklist.title: Verify cross-chain teleports can only use roots stored in globalTransferRoots
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate teleport/withdrawal function in Verifier.sol
2. Verify root validation checks globalTransferRoots[aggSeq]
3. Confirm zero/unmapped aggSeq causes revert
4. Check no bypass paths allow using unstored roots
5. Verify DATA-GLOBAL-TRANSFER-ROOT is correctly referenced

executable_checks.assertion: Global roots used for teleport validation

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SAVED -> Node STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SAVED. Reachability: UNREACHABLE - Cross-chain teleport validation checks globalTransferRoots[aggSeq]. Only stored roots pass validation.

checklist.title: Verify corrupted indexer state cannot compromise on-chain security
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Review indexer service architecture
2. Verify indexer-generated proofs are verified on-chain
3. Confirm corrupted indexer proofs fail ZK verification
4. Check users can independently verify indexer outputs
5. Verify ACTOR-INDEXER-SERVICE trust level is semi-trusted

executable_checks.assertion: Indexer is semi-trusted with on-chain verification as backup

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-INDEXER-IDLE -> Node STATE-INDEXER-IDLE. Reachability: REACHABLE_BENIGN - Indexer is semi-trusted. Corrupted indexer produces invalid Merkle proofs which fail on-chain verification. Security not dependent on indexer integrity.

checklist.title: Verify fake events from unauthorized contracts fail on-chain verification
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Review event watching logic in indexer service
2. Verify indexer filters by contract address
3. Confirm fake events result in invalid Merkle proofs
4. Check on-chain hash chain is authoritative for verification
5. Verify DATA-INDEXED-TRANSFER-EVENT source validation

executable_checks.command: Trace event to proof to on-chain verification
executable_checks.assertion: Invalid events produce invalid proofs that fail verification

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-INDEXER-WATCH-EVENTS -> Node ACTION-INDEXER-WATCH-EVENTS. Reachability: REACHABLE_VERIFIABLE - Even if fake events indexed, resulting Merkle proofs fail on-chain verification against actual hash chain state. On-chain state is authoritative.

checklist.title: Verify divergent indexer Merkle trees produce invalid proofs that fail on-chain
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Review Merkle tree construction in indexer
2. Verify tree matches on-chain hash chain structure
3. Confirm divergent trees produce proofs that fail ZK circuit
4. Check users can detect indexer misbehavior
5. Verify DATA-TRANSFER-ROOT consistency between indexer and on-chain

executable_checks.command: Compare indexer tree structure with on-chain hash chain

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-INDEXER-BUILD-TREE -> Node ACTION-INDEXER-BUILD-TREE. Reachability: REACHABLE_VERIFIABLE - Divergent trees produce proofs that fail on-chain verification. Users can detect and report indexer misbehavior. Economic incentive for correct indexing.

checklist.title: Verify incomplete Merkle trees produce proofs that fail ZK witness generation
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Review tree readiness checks in indexer
2. Verify partial tree proofs fail witness generation
3. Confirm users receive clear error for incomplete proofs
4. Check retry mechanism exists for incomplete trees

executable_checks.command: Review error handling for incomplete tree queries

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-INDEXER-TREE-READY -> Node STATE-INDEXER-TREE-READY. Reachability: REACHABLE_BENIGN - Incomplete proofs fail ZK circuit witness generation. Users simply retry with complete tree. No security impact.

checklist.title: Verify indexer-generated Merkle proofs are verified within ZK circuits
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Review proof generation in indexer
2. Verify generated proofs are consumed by ZK circuits
3. Confirm ZK circuit verifies proofs against on-chain roots
4. Check DATA-HISTORICAL-PROOF format matches circuit expectations
5. Verify end-to-end proof verification flow

executable_checks.command: Trace proof from indexer through ZK circuit verification
executable_checks.assertion: All proofs verified in ZK circuit

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-INDEXER-GENERATE-PROOFS -> Node ACTION-INDEXER-GENERATE-PROOFS. Reachability: REACHABLE_VERIFIABLE - All generated proofs are verified within ZK circuits against on-chain committed roots. Invalid proofs result in rejected ZK proofs. Cryptographic guarantee: Merkle proof + ZK verification.

checklist.title: Verify malicious prover cannot forge valid Groth16 proofs
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Review prover service architecture
2. Verify prover uses same circuit as on-chain verifier
3. Confirm Groth16 soundness prevents proof forgery
4. Check malformed proofs fail on-chain verification
5. Verify ACTOR-DECIDER-PROVER-SERVICE trust model
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-PROVER-IDLE -> Node STATE-PROVER-IDLE. Reachability: REACHABLE_BENIGN - Malicious prover cannot forge valid Groth16 proofs due to soundness. Can only fail to produce proofs or produce invalid ones (which fail on-chain verification). Cryptographic guarantee: Groth16 soundness.

checklist.title: Verify prover locally verifies IVC proofs before Groth16 conversion
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate IVC deserialization in prover service
2. Verify local IVC verification occurs before conversion
3. Confirm invalid IVC is rejected early
4. Check DATA-NOVA-IVC-PROOF format validation
5. Even if validation skipped, verify Groth16 output fails on-chain

executable_checks.command: Review IVC reception and validation flow
executable_checks.assertion: IVC verified before expensive Groth16 computation

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-PROVER-RECEIVE-IVC -> Node ACTION-PROVER-RECEIVE-IVC. Reachability: REACHABLE_BENIGN - Even if invalid IVC accepted, resulting Groth16 proof would be invalid and fail on-chain verification. No security impact (defense in depth).

checklist.title: Verify job queue manipulation cannot affect proof validity
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Review job queue implementation in prover service
2. Verify queue ordering is for fairness, not security
3. Confirm priority manipulation doesn't affect proof output
4. Check all jobs eventually processed regardless of order

executable_checks.command: Review queue fairness vs security properties

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-JOB-QUEUED -> Node STATE-JOB-QUEUED. Reachability: REACHABLE_BENIGN - Queue ordering is availability/fairness concern, not security. Priority manipulation doesn't affect proof validity.

checklist.title: Verify stalled job processing only affects availability not security
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Review job processing state machine
2. Verify stalled jobs don't produce partial outputs
3. Confirm users can retry with different prover
4. Check timeout handling for stalled jobs

executable_checks.assertion: Processing state and timeout handling exists

executable_checks.command: Review job timeout and retry mechanism
executable_checks.assertion: Stalled jobs timeout cleanly with retry option

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-JOB-PROCESSING -> Node STATE-JOB-PROCESSING. Reachability: REACHABLE_BENIGN - Stalled processing affects availability only. Users can retry with different prover service.

checklist.title: Verify Groth16 proof production requires valid IVC input (soundness)
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Review Nova-to-Groth16 conversion in prover
2. Verify circuit enforces IVC validity
3. Confirm invalid IVC produces invalid Groth16 (fails on-chain)
4. Check DATA-GROTH16-PROOF is correctly bound to IVC
5. Verify cryptographic parameters match on-chain verifier

executable_checks.assertion: IVC to Groth16 conversion logic exists
Invalid IVC cannot produce valid Groth16

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-PROVER-CONVERT-TO-GROTH16 -> Node ACTION-PROVER-CONVERT-TO-GROTH16. Reachability: UNREACHABLE - Groth16 proving circuit enforces IVC validity. Invalid IVC produces invalid Groth16 proof that fails on-chain verification. Cryptographic guarantee: Groth16 soundness + Nova folding.

checklist.title: Verify completed job Groth16 proof passes on-chain verification
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Review completed job output format
2. Verify Groth16 proof format matches on-chain verifier
3. Confirm prover uses same verification key as on-chain
4. Check DATA-GROTH16-PROOF is correctly formatted for submission
5. Test end-to-end proof verification

executable_checks.assertion: Completed job proof passes on-chain verification
Prover and on-chain verifier use same key

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-JOB-COMPLETED -> Node STATE-JOB-COMPLETED. Reachability: UNREACHABLE - Groth16 proof soundness ensures validity. Prover uses same verification key as on-chain verifier. Cryptographic guarantee: Groth16.
